string-array.name: charter_lines
string-array.item: No advertisements. Ever, in any build.
No behavioural tracking. Ghostdeck learns from your use only on your device, for you, and shows you everything it has learned (11a.3).
No selling or sharing of data. There is no server to send it to.
Local-first. All settings, layouts and learned signals live on the device. Export them yourself if you want them anywhere else.
Optional AI, on-device by default. Cloud AI only through the separate Link plugin, with your own keys, and nothing is sent without you seeing exactly what.
Transparent permissions. Every permission is requested at the moment it\'s needed, with a plain-language reason, and listed in the Privacy Ledger.
No account. Nothing to sign up for, ever.
